role_summary: Director-level strategic role responsible for defining enterprise architecture, governing technology roadmaps, and leading hands-on solution design and systems integration to support global luxury operations.
must_have_requirements: Experience in Enterprise Architecture frameworks (TOGAF or equivalent)
Proven track record in end-to-end solution design involving cloud and on-premises hybrid environments
Deep expertise in systems integration and data architecture
Director-level experience in stakeholder management and organizational alignment
Background in building scalable, secure, and resilient technology ecosystems
nice_to_have_requirements: Hands-on experience implementing AI-driven enterprise technologies
Direct experience in the hospitality or luxury retail industries
Management of technical and business solution lead teams

scoring_criteria.name: Enterprise Architecture Governance
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: The role defines the architectural standards for a multi-national luxury group.

scoring_criteria.name: Hybrid Architecture & Integration
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Essential for managing complex hospitalities systems spanning cloud and on-prem.

scoring_criteria.name: Strategic Stakeholder Engagement
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must bridge the gap between business leads and technical teams effectively.

scoring_criteria.name: Luxury/Hospitality Domain Knowledge
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Understanding high-touch service requirements ensures technology fits the brand promise.

scoring_criteria.name: Hands-on Delivery & Technical Acumen
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: This is a working-architect role, not just governance.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Management-only roles with no design responsibility

scoring_criteria.name: AI & Innovation Implementation
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: The JD specifically mandates advanced AI technology readiness.

scoring_criteria.name: Director-Level Leadership
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Authority to lead internal IT counterparts and business solution leads.

scoring_criteria.name: Values Alignment (Cultural Fit)
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: High-luxury demands integrity, responsibility, and a guest-centric mindset.

summary_focus: High-level impact on global architectural strategy in the hospitality or premium service sector.
do_not_overclaim: Avoid claiming 'hands-on coding' if the role is purely managerial; balance the two as requested by the 'rare blend' requirement.

cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Emphasize how your architectural vision scales service delivery without compromising the 'human' element of luxury.
bridge_gaps_honestly: If moving from a different industry, connect your deep expertise in complex, mission-critical systems to the needs of the luxury hospitality industry.
